proofs.scope: 35 frozen whole-program workflow cases include deferred child flags plus literal --; terminal/image/artifact guidance and source numeric formatting are checked.
All seven source release scenarios, self-update refusals, physical installed-fixture identity and same-ID publication/bootstrap/official-install guards.

Bundled entry is recognized while workspace JS entry is not.
nativeAssertions: Embedded build/version/source/target metadata survive relocation and ignore forged runtime build environment.
Reported executable digest equals actual bytes. An allocated native ID cannot be rebound to changed content.

implementation.identity: Embedded BUILD_ID/VERSION and actual executable path/target/bytes must match verified installed metadata; active/provisional state is read afresh. Environment markers alone are insufficient.
implementation.cache: A single-entry successful byte-verification cache is keyed by canonical store/exe path, canonical manifest digest and kernel device/inode/size/mtime/ctime nanoseconds; stat is checked again after hashing. Small metadata/state remain fresh.
implementation.asyncOwnership: All async managed-store gates run blocking work off the reactor. Controller Arc/instance leases are captured through blocking gates and healthy confirmation; worker confirmation retains its instance lease.
implementation.confirmation: Old stable bytes remain until authenticated role health. Confirmation and atomic verified refresh share the install lock. A refresh error is explicit while healthy confirmation remains committed.
implementation.review: Behavior owner independently reviewed identity/cache/state invalidation, provisional previous no-op, nonfatal refresh and blocking ownership; no high-confidence introduced issue found.

limits: Linux x86_64 local proof. Actual Mac overlay/runtime evidence is owned by parent/behavior.

Node state fields and npm/package identity formulas are explicitly replaced; retained native version-switch, argument, confirmation, rollback and launcher-refresh behavior is verified.
No signing, publication, reboot or external target claim.

sameIdPublication.red: An internally consistent changed bundle reused the active ID and returned HTTP200/action:none, allowing a fresh current-build mirror to be populated with conflicting artifacts.
sameIdPublication.correction: The verified active store manifest anchors same-ID input before mirror mutation. Publisher import, official installation and bootstrap all compare the entire parsed manifest; changed input is rejected, identical publication remains idempotent.
assertions: Collision is rejected before current mirror manifest/artifacts are written.
Installed active manifest/current/pending state remain unchanged.
Repeated honest identical bundle returns action:none twice.
Bootstrap and official install fetch only tag metadata, checksums and manifest; no target archive is requested after collision.
